notes: 10H-D end-to-end measured-output update gate. Clients observe yaw rate, lateral acceleration, applied steering, speed, and steering command over one frozen 10H speed block/frequency band. A single fixed nominal fleet-physics KF reconstructs pseudo-states locally. Offline trajectory centering estimates constant sensor bias. Regularized local state-transition fits are shrunk toward the same nominal model, and only partial matrix summaries enter the unchanged unknown-K mixture. True states, matrices, and class labels are excluded from learning and used only for diagnostics/oracle comparators. The H03 Global LQI controller and 10H-A/B measurement and observer settings remain frozen.
